cg_markslimit.summary: The most bullet and explosion marks kept on screen at once.
cg_markslimit.details: From 0 to 1,024, and 1,024 by default. Fewer marks can ease heavy fights. It only matters while Bullet marks is on.

fx_cull.title: Hide unseen effects
fx_cull.summary: Skips drawing effects that are out of view.
fx_cull.details: A culling switch for the effects system. It is on by default and, unlike its neighbours, is not cheat-protected.

r_aaalpha.title: Smooth cut-out edges
r_aaalpha.summary: How the game smooths the edges of textures with see-through cut-outs.
r_aaalpha.details: Choices are off, a quick dither and a slower supersample. Higher quality costs speed. It is saved with your config.

r_gpusync.title: CPU and GPU syncing
r_gpusync.summary: How strictly the game keeps your processor and graphics card in step.
r_gpusync.details: Choices are off, beginning, before present and adaptive, and adaptive is the default. Lower settings can raise frame rate but may add mouse and keyboard lag, which is why the game's makers chose adaptive.

r_ignorehwgamma.title: Ignore display gamma
r_ignorehwgamma.summary: Tells the game not to use the display's hardware brightness curve.
r_ignorehwgamma.details: The exact effect is not documented. It is latched, so a change applies after the renderer restarts.

r_ingamevideo.title: In-game video
r_ingamevideo.summary: Plays video that appears on in-game screens.

r_monitor.title: Monitor number
r_monitor.summary: Which monitor the game uses in full screen.
r_monitor.details: From 0 to 8, and the name suggests the monitor's position in the list. It is latched, so a change applies after the renderer restarts.

r_depthprepassmodels.title: Model depth pre-pass
r_depthprepassmodels.summary: Draws model depth in a first pass before the models themselves.
r_depthprepassmodels.details: Off by default, and the game's safe mode sets it to off. Its effect is inferred from the name.

r_skincache.title: Cache model skins
r_skincache.summary: Keeps model skin data ready so models draw more smoothly.
r_skincache.details: On by default. TweakGuide says to turn it off only on very low memory.

r_smc_enable.title: Static model cache
r_smc_enable.summary: Turns on the cache the game keeps for static models.

r_sse_skinning.title: SSE model skinning
r_sse_skinning.summary: A switch registered for faster model animation.
r_sse_skinning.details: On by default. This version of the game only registers it and never reads the value.

r_optimize.title: Optimise geometry on load
r_optimize.summary: Tidies map geometry when a map loads.
r_optimize.details: On by default. It is latched, so a change applies after the renderer restarts.

r_optimizelightmaps.title: Optimise lightmaps on load
r_optimizelightmaps.summary: Tidies a map's baked lighting when it loads.
r_optimizelightmaps.details: On by default. It is latched, so a change applies after the renderer restarts.

r_optimizexmodels.title: Optimise models on load
r_optimizexmodels.summary: How hard the game tidies model data when a map loads.
r_optimizexmodels.details: From 0 to 1,000, and 100 by default. It is latched, so a change applies after the renderer restarts.

r_overbrightbits.title: Light intensity scaling
r_overbrightbits.summary: Scales how bright map lighting is drawn.
r_overbrightbits.details: Believed to scale baked lighting intensity, from its Quake heritage. The setting accepts 0 or 1 and is latched. ESL's old PunkBuster list allowed 0 to 2.

r_polygonoffsetbias.title: Mark depth offset
r_polygonoffsetbias.summary: Pushes wall marks and overlays toward or away from the surface they sit on.
r_polygonoffsetbias.details: From -16 to 16, and -1 by default. Large values make bullet marks and overlay textures disappear, which some players use to spot enemies more easily. Rule sets treat unusual values as suspect: ESL's old PunkBuster list allowed -1 to 16 and a later PunkBuster template required exactly -1.

r_polygonoffsetscale.title: Mark depth slope
r_polygonoffsetscale.summary: Adjusts the same wall-mark depth offset on sloped surfaces.
r_polygonoffsetscale.details: From -4 to 4, and -1 by default. Unusual values are treated as suspect: ESL's old PunkBuster list allowed -1 to 4.

r_presentmode.title: Frame presenting mode
r_presentmode.summary: Chooses whether the game skips showing a frame while the last one is still being drawn.
r_presentmode.details: 0 shows every frame. 1 waits for the graphics card to finish the previous frame and, if it has not, skips showing this one so the screen never shows an older picture. It comes from the macOS version of the game and is saved with your config.

vid_xpos.title: Window left position
vid_xpos.summary: Where the game window sits from the left of the screen when windowed.
vid_xpos.details: The game saves it every time you move the window. The range is -4,096 to 4,096.

vid_ypos.title: Window top position
vid_ypos.summary: Where the game window sits from the top of the screen when windowed.
vid_ypos.details: The game saves it every time you move the window. The range is -4,096 to 4,096.

r_railcorewidth.title: Rail beam width
r_railcorewidth.summary: A leftover Quake 3 setting for the width of a rail beam.
r_railcorewidth.details: No effect is known in CoD2.

r_clearcolor.title: Screen clear colour
r_clearcolor.summary: A colour the renderer clears the screen to before drawing.
r_clearcolor.details: Its exact use is not documented. The default is black.

r_clearcolor2.title: Second clear colour
r_clearcolor2.summary: A second colour the renderer clears the screen to.
r_clearcolor2.details: Its exact use is not documented. The default is black.

r_objectivecolordx7max.title: Objective colour, high
r_objectivecolordx7max.summary: The brighter colour used for objectives in the DirectX 7 renderer.
r_objectivecolordx7max.details: Its role is inferred from its name.

r_objectivecolordx7min.title: Objective colour, low
r_objectivecolordx7min.summary: The darker colour used for objectives in the DirectX 7 renderer.
r_objectivecolordx7min.details: Its role is inferred from its name.

r_outdoorawaybias.title: Outdoor away bias
r_outdoorawaybias.summary: A renderer tuning value for outdoor scenes.
r_outdoorawaybias.details: Its exact effect is not documented.

r_outdoordownbias.title: Outdoor down bias
r_outdoordownbias.summary: A renderer tuning value for outdoor scenes.
r_outdoordownbias.details: Its exact effect is not documented.

r_outdoorfeather.title: Outdoor feather
r_outdoorfeather.summary: A renderer tuning value for outdoor scenes.
r_outdoorfeather.details: Its exact effect is not documented.

r_portalbevels.title: Portal bevel amount
r_portalbevels.summary: A renderer tuning value for portal visibility.
r_portalbevels.details: From 0 to 1, and 0.7 by default. It is saved with your config. Its exact effect is not documented.

cg_scripticonsize.title: Script icon size
cg_scripticonsize.summary: How large icons placed by game scripts are.

cg_subtitlemintime.title: Subtitle minimum time
cg_subtitlemintime.summary: The fewest seconds a subtitle stays on screen.

cg_subtitleposx.title: Subtitle left position
cg_subtitleposx.summary: Where subtitles sit from the left of the screen.

cg_subtitleposy.title: Subtitle top position
cg_subtitleposy.summary: Where subtitles sit from the top of the screen.

cg_subtitlewidthstandard.title: Subtitle width, standard
cg_subtitlewidthstandard.summary: How many characters wide subtitles are on a standard screen.

cg_subtitlewidthwidescreen.title: Subtitle width, widescreen
cg_subtitlewidthwidescreen.summary: How many characters wide subtitles are on a widescreen display.

cg_viewsize.title: View size
cg_viewsize.summary: How much of the screen the 3D view fills.
cg_viewsize.details: A percentage from 30 to 100, and 100 by default. Its effect in CoD2 is inferred from its Quake heritage. ESL's old PunkBuster list required 100. zPAM sets it to 100 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it.

cg_voiceiconsize.title: Voice icon size
cg_voiceiconsize.summary: How large the voice chat icon is; 0 hides it.

cg_voicespritetime.title: Voice sprite time
cg_voicespritetime.summary: How many milliseconds a voice sprite stays on screen.

cg_youinkillcamsize.title: Kill-cam marker size
cg_youinkillcamsize.summary: How large the 'you' marker is in the kill cam.

cg_footsteps.title: Footstep sounds
cg_footsteps.summary: Whether footstep sounds and effects play.
cg_footsteps.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_sound.title: Shell shock sound
cg_shock_sound.summary: Whether the shell shock sound effect plays.
cg_shock_sound.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_sounddrylevel.title: Shock sound dry level
cg_shock_sounddrylevel.summary: How much of the unprocessed sound is heard during shell shock.
cg_shock_sounddrylevel.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_soundwetlevel.title: Shock sound wet level
cg_shock_soundwetlevel.summary: How much of the processed sound is heard during shell shock.
cg_shock_soundwetlevel.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_soundfadeintime.title: Shock sound fade in
cg_shock_soundfadeintime.summary: How many seconds the shell shock sound takes to fade in.
cg_shock_soundfadeintime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_soundfadeouttime.title: Shock sound fade out
cg_shock_soundfadeouttime.summary: How many seconds the shell shock sound takes to fade out.
cg_shock_soundfadeouttime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_soundloopfadetime.title: Shock loop fade time
cg_shock_soundloopfadetime.summary: How many seconds the shell shock loop takes to fade.
cg_shock_soundloopfadetime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_soundloopenddelay.title: Shock loop end delay
cg_shock_soundloopenddelay.summary: A delay, in seconds, for the end of the shell shock loop.
cg_shock_soundloopenddelay.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_soundmodenddelay.title: Shock sound end delay
cg_shock_soundmodenddelay.summary: A delay, in seconds, for the end of the shell shock sound change.
cg_shock_soundmodenddelay.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_soundroomtype.title: Shock sound room type
cg_shock_soundroomtype.summary: The room type used for the shell shock sound effect.
cg_shock_soundroomtype.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. Choices run from generic through underwater, drugged, dizzy and psychotic.

cg_shock_volume_announcer.title: Shock volume: announcer
cg_shock_volume_announcer.summary: How loud the announcer is during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_announcer.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_auto.title: Shock volume: auto
cg_shock_volume_auto.summary: How loud automatic sounds are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_auto.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_auto2d.title: Shock volume: auto 2D
cg_shock_volume_auto2d.summary: How loud automatic 2D sounds are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_auto2d.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_body.title: Shock volume: body
cg_shock_volume_body.summary: How loud body sounds are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_body.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_item.title: Shock volume: items
cg_shock_volume_item.summary: How loud item sounds are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_item.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_local.title: Shock volume: local
cg_shock_volume_local.summary: How loud local sounds are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_local.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_menu.title: Shock volume: menu
cg_shock_volume_menu.summary: How loud menu sounds are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_menu.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_music.title: Shock volume: music
cg_shock_volume_music.summary: How loud the music is during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_music.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_shellshock.title: Shock volume: shock
cg_shock_volume_shellshock.summary: How loud the shell shock sounds themselves are.
cg_shock_volume_shellshock.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_voice.title: Shock volume: voices
cg_shock_volume_voice.summary: How loud voices are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_voice.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

cg_shock_volume_weapon.title: Shock volume: weapons
cg_shock_volume_weapon.summary: How loud weapons are during shell shock.
cg_shock_volume_weapon.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from 0 to 1.

voice_deadchat.title: Hear dead players
voice_deadchat.summary: Lets you hear the voice chat of dead players.

voice_global.title: Global voice chat
voice_global.summary: Makes voice chat audible to everyone.

voice_localecho.title: Hear yourself
voice_localecho.summary: Plays your own voice back to you.

cg_shock_mouse.title: Shock mouse effect
cg_shock_mouse.summary: Whether shell shock affects your mouse.
cg_shock_mouse.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

cg_shock_mouse_fadetime.title: Shock mouse fade
cg_shock_mouse_fadetime.summary: How many seconds the shell shock mouse effect takes to fade.
cg_shock_mouse_fadetime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 2 seconds.

cg_shock_mouse_maxpitchspeed.title: Shock mouse tilt limit
cg_shock_mouse_maxpitchspeed.summary: The fastest your view may tilt during shell shock.
cg_shock_mouse_maxpitchspeed.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 90.

cg_shock_mouse_maxyawspeed.title: Shock mouse turn limit
cg_shock_mouse_maxyawspeed.summary: The fastest your view may turn during shell shock.
cg_shock_mouse_maxyawspeed.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 90.

cg_shock_mouse_sensitivityscale.title: Shock mouse speed
cg_shock_mouse_sensitivityscale.summary: How much shell shock scales your mouse speed.
cg_shock_mouse_sensitivityscale.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.5.

cg_shock_screenblendfadetime.title: Shock blend fade
cg_shock_screenblendfadetime.summary: How many seconds the shell shock screen tint takes to fade.
cg_shock_screenblendfadetime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 1 second.

cg_shock_screenblendtime.title: Shock blend time
cg_shock_screenblendtime.summary: How many seconds the shell shock screen tint builds.
cg_shock_screenblendtime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.4 seconds.

cg_shock_viewkickfadetime.title: Shock view kick fade
cg_shock_viewkickfadetime.summary: How many seconds the shell shock view kick takes to fade.
cg_shock_viewkickfadetime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 3 seconds.

cg_shock_viewkickperiod.title: Shock view kick period
cg_shock_viewkickperiod.summary: How long one shell shock view kick lasts.
cg_shock_viewkickperiod.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.75 seconds.

cg_shock_viewkickradius.title: Shock view kick size
cg_shock_viewkickradius.summary: How far shell shock kicks your view.
cg_shock_viewkickradius.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 0.05.

cg_errordecay.title: Prediction smoothing
cg_errordecay.summary: How fast your game smooths out corrections to your predicted position.
cg_errordecay.details: The default is 100. zPAM sets it to 100 for every player after they join a team, so a saved value is replaced on servers running it. ESL's old PunkBuster list also required 100.

cg_nopredict.title: Turn off prediction
cg_nopredict.summary: Stops your game predicting your own movement.
cg_nopredict.details: A debugging aid: movement waits for the server, so the game feels laggy. Off by default and not saved.

cg_predictitems.title: Predict item pickups
cg_predictitems.summary: Lets your game predict picking up items before the server confirms.
cg_predictitems.details: On by default, and shared with the server as player information.

cg_showmiss.title: Show prediction misses
cg_showmiss.summary: Shows when your game's prediction was wrong.
cg_showmiss.details: A developer aid from 0 to 2, off by default.

showdrop.title: Show dropped packets
showdrop.summary: Prints a note when a packet is dropped.
showdrop.details: A developer aid. It is off by default.

showpackets.title: Show every packet
showpackets.summary: Prints every packet sent and received.
showpackets.details: A developer aid. It is off by default and floods the console.

packetdebug.title: Packet debugging
packetdebug.details: A developer aid. It is off by default.

rcon_password.title: Remote console password
rcon_password.summary: The password for controlling a server remotely.
rcon_password.details: Treat it as private. It is not saved to your config.

nextmap.title: Next map
nextmap.summary: The map a server you host loads next.
nextmap.details: It only matters on a server you host. The default is empty.

g_antilag.title: Lag compensation
g_antilag.summary: Rewinds players when you fire so hits land where you saw them, on a server you host.
g_antilag.details: On by default. Rule sets differ: FPSChallenge's EU text and zPAM's EU rules want it off, and zPAM's NA rules want it on. It only matters on a server you host.

g_banips.title: Banned addresses
g_banips.summary: The list of banned addresses for a server you host.
g_banips.details: Saved with your config. It only matters on a server you host.

g_cloneplayermaxvelocity.title: Body push speed
g_cloneplayermaxvelocity.summary: A limit on how fast a dead player's body is pushed.
g_cloneplayermaxvelocity.details: The default is 80. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_deadchat.title: Dead players chat
g_deadchat.summary: Lets dead players chat with the living on a server you host.
g_deadchat.details: Off by default. zPAM registers its own default of on.

g_dropforwardspeed.title: Weapon drop forward speed
g_dropforwardspeed.summary: A tuning value for how dropped weapons fly out.
g_dropforwardspeed.details: The default is 10. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_dropupspeedbase.title: Weapon drop up speed
g_dropupspeedbase.summary: A tuning value for how dropped weapons fly out.
g_dropupspeedbase.details: The default is 10. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_dropupspeedrand.title: Weapon drop up variation
g_dropupspeedrand.summary: A tuning value for how dropped weapons fly out.
g_dropupspeedrand.details: The default is 5. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_gametype.title: Game type
g_gametype.summary: Which game type a server you host runs.
g_gametype.details: Stock choices are ctf, dm, hq, sd and tdm, and zPAM adds htf, re and strat. A change applies from the next map because it is latched. It only matters on a server you host.

g_gravity.title: Server gravity
g_gravity.summary: How strongly gravity pulls on a server you host.
g_gravity.details: The default is 800 game units per second squared. It only matters on a server you host.

g_inactivity.title: Idle kick time
g_inactivity.summary: Drops players who are idle this many seconds on a server you host; 0 is off.
g_inactivity.details: The server warns them 10 seconds before. The local player is exempt.

g_knockback.title: Hit knockback
g_knockback.summary: How hard hits push players back on a server you host.
g_knockback.details: The default is 1,000, and zPAM sets it to 0. It only matters on a server you host.

g_listentity.title: List entities
g_listentity.summary: A developer switch that lists the server's entities.
g_listentity.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

g_log.title: Game log file
g_log.summary: The file a server you host writes its game log to.
g_log.details: The default is the standard game log name. It only matters on a server you host.

g_logsync.title: Log immediately
g_logsync.summary: Writes the game log straight to disk instead of buffering it.
g_logsync.details: Off by default. It only matters on a server you host.

g_maxdroppedweapons.title: Dropped weapon limit
g_maxdroppedweapons.summary: The most dropped weapons left lying around on a server you host.

g_motd.title: Hosted server message
g_motd.summary: A message of the day for a server you host.
g_motd.details: It only matters on a server you host. The default is empty.

g_no_script_spam.title: Limit script spam
g_no_script_spam.summary: A switch the game registers to limit script message spam.
g_no_script_spam.details: Off by default. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_oldvoting.title: Old voting system
g_oldvoting.summary: Uses the older voting system on a server you host.
g_oldvoting.details: On by default. zPAM's comment says it must stay on or voting does not work.

g_playercollisionejectspeed.title: Player push-apart speed
g_playercollisionejectspeed.summary: How fast overlapping players are pushed apart.
g_playercollisionejectspeed.details: From 0 to 32,000, and 25 by default. It only matters on a server you host.

g_scoresbanner_allies.title: Allies scoreboard banner
g_scoresbanner_allies.summary: The scoreboard banner image for the Allies.
g_scoresbanner_allies.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

g_scoresbanner_axis.title: Axis scoreboard banner
g_scoresbanner_axis.summary: The scoreboard banner image for the Axis.
g_scoresbanner_axis.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

g_scoresbanner_none.title: Neutral scoreboard banner
g_scoresbanner_none.summary: The scoreboard banner image for no team.
g_scoresbanner_none.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player.

g_scoresbanner_spectators.title: Spectator scoreboard banner
g_scoresbanner_spectators.summary: The scoreboard banner image for spectators.
g_scoresbanner_spectators.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player.

g_teamcolor_allies.title: Allies team colour
g_teamcolor_allies.summary: The colour used for the Allies.
g_teamcolor_allies.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

g_teamcolor_axis.title: Axis team colour
g_teamcolor_axis.summary: The colour used for the Axis.
g_teamcolor_axis.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

g_teamname_allies.title: Allies team name
g_teamname_allies.summary: The name shown for the Allies.
g_teamname_allies.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

g_teamname_axis.title: Axis team name
g_teamname_axis.summary: The name shown for the Axis.
g_teamname_axis.details: The server sets this and shares it with every player. Game scripts write it, so a saved value may be replaced.

g_smoothclients.title: Smooth other players
g_smoothclients.summary: Smooths other players' movement on a server you host.
g_smoothclients.details: On by default. The server extrapolates players' positions before it sends updates.

g_speed.title: Player run speed
g_speed.summary: How fast players run on a server you host.
g_speed.details: The default is 190 game units per second. It only matters on a server you host.

g_synchronousclients.title: Synchronous player logic
g_synchronousclients.summary: Runs each player's logic once per server frame, which smooths demos.
g_synchronousclients.details: Off by default. The server shares it with every player.

g_useholdtime.title: Use-key hold time
g_useholdtime.summary: How long a player must hold the use key.
g_useholdtime.details: The default is 0. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_voicechattalkingduration.title: Voice talking time
g_voicechattalkingduration.summary: How long a player is shown as talking after they speak.
g_voicechattalkingduration.details: From 0 to 10,000, and 500 by default. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_voteabstainweight.title: Abstain vote weight
g_voteabstainweight.summary: How much a player who does not vote counts toward a vote.
g_voteabstainweight.details: From 0 to 1, and 0.5 by default. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_weaponammopools.title: Shared ammo pools
g_weaponammopools.summary: A switch the game registers for sharing weapon ammo.
g_weaponammopools.details: Off by default. It only matters on a server you host. Its role is inferred from its name.

g_debugbullets.title: Bullet debug level
g_debugbullets.summary: A developer switch for bullet debugging.
g_debugbullets.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It runs from -3 to 6.

g_debugdamage.title: Damage debug
g_debugdamage.summary: A developer switch for damage debugging.
g_debugdamage.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

g_debuglocdamage.title: Hit location debug
g_debuglocdamage.summary: A developer switch for hit-location damage debugging.
g_debuglocdamage.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

g_dumpanims.title: Server animation dump
g_dumpanims.summary: A developer switch that dumps an entity's animations.
g_dumpanims.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting.

g_friendlyfiredist.title: Friendly-fire distance
g_friendlyfiredist.summary: A distance used for friendly-fire handling.
g_friendlyfiredist.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 256.

g_friendlynamedist.title: Friendly name distance
g_friendlynamedist.summary: How far away a friendly player's name shows.
g_friendlynamedist.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 15,000.

g_mantleblocktimebuffer.title: Mantle block time
g_mantleblocktimebuffer.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 500 milliseconds.

g_shotgun_spread_fix.title: Fixed shotgun pattern
g_shotgun_spread_fix.summary: Uses a fixed eight-pellet pattern for shotguns instead of random spread.
g_shotgun_spread_fix.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. CoD2x only. The server picks one of two fixed patterns for each shot.

g_useholdspawndelay.title: Spawn use delay
g_useholdspawndelay.summary: A server delay, in seconds, before players can use things after spawning.
g_useholdspawndelay.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 1.

timescale.title: Game speed
timescale.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. The default is 1, and servers share it. It is used for demos and slow motion.

fixedtime.title: Fixed frame time
fixedtime.summary: Forces every frame to last a fixed number of milliseconds.
fixedtime.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. 0 is off. zPAM sets it to 0 for every player.

cg_weaponcycledelay.title: Weapon cycle delay
cg_weaponcycledelay.summary: A delay, in milliseconds, between weapon-cycle key presses.
cg_weaponcycledelay.details: 0 by default. zPAM briefly sets it to 200 to prevent the fast-reload double-scroll trick, then back to 0.

cg_weaponleftbone.title: Left weapon bone
cg_weaponleftbone.summary: The model tag the left-hand weapon attaches to.
cg_weaponleftbone.details: The default is the left weapon tag.

cg_weaponrightbone.title: Right weapon bone
cg_weaponrightbone.summary: The model tag the right-hand weapon attaches to.
cg_weaponrightbone.details: The default is the right weapon tag.

activeaction.title: Active action
activeaction.summary: A text value the game keeps for the current menu action.
activeaction.details: The registered default is empty. Its use is not documented.

com_animcheck.title: Animation check
com_animcheck.summary: A developer switch for checking animations.
com_animcheck.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

com_expectedhunkusage.title: Expected memory use
com_expectedhunkusage.summary: A hint of the main memory the current map is expected to need.
com_expectedhunkusage.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself.

com_freezewatch.title: Freeze watchdog
com_freezewatch.summary: Offers to save a crash report when the game stops responding.
com_freezewatch.details: CoD2x only, on by default. It checks every second and shows a 'has frozen' dialog after about 12 seconds without a heartbeat.

com_hunkmegs.title: Game memory
com_hunkmegs.summary: How many megabytes the game reserves for its main memory.
com_hunkmegs.details: Stock allows 1 to 512 with 160 by default. CoD2x pins it to 512. It is latched, so a change applies after the game restarts.

com_introplayed.title: Skip intro movies
com_introplayed.summary: Skips the opening publisher movies when set.
com_introplayed.details: Set to 1 to skip them. A guide suggests setting it on the launch line.

com_playerprofile.title: Active profile name
com_playerprofile.summary: The name of the profile the game is using.
com_playerprofile.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself. It comes from the active profile file when the game starts.

com_recommendedset.title: System check done
com_recommendedset.summary: Marks that the game's automatic system check has run.
com_recommendedset.details: Present in saved configs. Leave it alone.

com_statmon.title: Stat monitor
com_statmon.summary: A developer switch for a statistics monitor.
com_statmon.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

dedicated.title: Dedicated server mode
dedicated.summary: Whether this copy of the game runs as a dedicated server.
dedicated.details: The game treats this as read-only and sets it itself. The separate dedicated-server program is a different launch path. It is latched.

developer.title: Developer mode
developer.summary: Turns on developer printing and testing functions.
developer.details: From 0 to 2, and 0 for normal play. CoD2x forces 2 during demo playback only. It is not saved.

developer_script.title: Script developer output
developer_script.summary: Prints debug output from game scripts.
developer_script.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

fs_basegame.title: Base game folder
fs_basegame.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

fs_basepath.title: Install folder
fs_basepath.summary: The folder that contains the game's main folder.
fs_basepath.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

fs_cdpath.title: CD folder
fs_cdpath.summary: A folder the game can read files from, as if from a disc.
fs_cdpath.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

fs_copyfiles.title: Copy from CD folder
fs_copyfiles.summary: A Quake 3 style flag to copy files from the CD folder.
fs_copyfiles.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

fs_homepath.title: Game data folder
fs_homepath.summary: The folder where the game writes configs, demos, screenshots and logs.
fs_homepath.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

fs_ignorelocalized.title: Ignore localized files
fs_ignorelocalized.summary: A switch the game registers to ignore localized files.
fs_ignorelocalized.details: The game protects this setting: it only changes with cheats on, so it is not a player setting. It is latched.

fs_restrict.title: Restrict file access
fs_restrict.summary: A switch the game registers to restrict file access.
fs_restrict.details: It can only be set on the launch line, before the game starts, and the game protects it from changes here.

fs_game.title: Mod folder
fs_game.summary: The mod folder the game is using.
fs_game.details: The server shares it with players and the game protects it from changes here. CoD2x resets it to empty and restarts the file system when you leave a server.

fs_debug.title: File system debug
fs_debug.summary: A developer switch for file system debugging.
fs_debug.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here. It runs from 0 to 2.

fs_useoldassets.title: Use old assets
fs_useoldassets.summary: A switch the game registers to use older asset files.
fs_useoldassets.details: A developer aid; its effect is not documented here.

gamedate.title: Game build date
gamedate.summary: The date the game was built.
